t: Ready to use, dustable powder insecticide. Powder can be applied directly by dusting, by means of puffer pack. The active ingredient,Deltamethrin, can kill insects quickly on contact.Can be used on and around ants nests and other crawling insects, including cockroaches, spiders and bed bugs. Apply to cracks, crevices and any other places where insects might hide.
b: Not Suitable for Use Around Pets
Can be used Inside or Outside
